short: An assessment of your concerns, your circumstances, your history, and your current condition, through traditional approach of Ayurveda. The consultation is based on a functional and systemic assessment of your health issues and identifies rebalancing strategies tailored to your needs. It concludes with a summary that includes explanations and recommendations designed to address your symptoms and prevent the onset of new health issues (using Ayurvedic methods: diet, lifestyle, and herbal supplements). This leads generally to one or more follow-up sessions to pursue and adjust the recommendations according to the results.
pricing:
Initial consultation: 90€ - 90-120 minutes
Follow up consultation : 70€ - 60-90 minutes
long: I use the traditional Ayurvedic  to address the challenges of the modern world. Through this traditional approach, the body’s inherent natural wisdom, the source of health, can flourish again and allow vitality to express itself naturally. With concrete steps for daily change, based on our relationship with food, our lifestyle habits, and plant medicine, we gradually rediscover our connection to ourselves and deepen our sense of self, thereby gaining serenity, power, and efficiency.
